Fixed the outgoing-slot-release wedge. Crossfade completion now driven by the incoming slot's monotonic clock (immune to the outgoing AVAudioPlayer.currentTime reset at EOF), completeCrossfade made idempotent, handleTrackEnded force-completes a mid-fade crossfade, and cancelActiveCrossfade now keeps the preloaded next track loaded so a seek mid-fade re-triggers correctly. 5 regression tests in CrossfadeEngineTests; full suite 405/405 green; verified on device (end-of-track advance + seek-backward-mid-fade both correct). Sustained-playback drift (~3MB/min) deferred as benign: it decelerates/plateaus (~170MB) with 3.2GB headroom — revisit only if a longer multi-track log shows real unbounded growth.

Premise stale. TrackCache (ephemeral temp, max 5, LRU) and OfflineStore (persistent downloads) do not overlap. QueueManager only routes URLs into TrackCache when !isFileURL (QueueManager.swift:220,292); offline tracks resolve to file:// and bypass TrackCache entirely, so 'TrackCache may re-cache already-offline tracks' cannot occur through the queue. No unification needed.

The real remaining redundant decode was Up Next rows: same-album distinct tracks each re-decoded the 120px thumb on every fresh window build (the gap 7.2's per-track row reuse left). New thumbArtMemo (CoalescingMemo cap 20 = window size, shouldCache rejects nil to preserve retry) dedupes per album within a window and across rebuilds. 3 new deterministic tests (=== identity, request-count dedup, screen-level same-album dedup).
